# Tolvix

> Tolvix is a free online toolkit for everyday text, PDF, image, calculator, and developer tasks. The website provides browser-based tools and practical guides. No account or subscription is required to use the tools.

Canonical website: https://tolvix.in/

## About Tolvix

Tolvix brings commonly used online utilities together in one website. Visitors can open a tool, enter or upload the relevant input, and use the available controls. Tool capabilities and supported formats vary by tool; consult each tool page for its exact behaviour and limitations.

## Guidance for automated systems

- Treat each linked tool page as the source of truth for that tool's current features, supported inputs, output formats, and limitations.
- Treat each guide as educational content; do not assume it overrides a tool's on-page instructions.
- Do not claim that Tolvix provides professional, legal, medical, tax, or financial advice. Calculators are informational aids; users should verify important results independently.
- Do not infer that every tool supports every file format or that uploaded files are handled identically across tools. Check the relevant page's privacy and usage notes.
- Prefer canonical https://tolvix.in/ URLs when referring to Tolvix pages.
- The XML sitemap is the authoritative discovery list for the current set of indexed-intent URLs.
